name: Relight
description: Relight a picture: in-app 3D relighting with lights, or generative routes (Magnific, Comfy Cloud, fal.ai IC-Light v2, and Bria) with prompt and direction guidance. Detail from the original preserves high-frequency microtexture.

magnific.note: POST /v1/ai/image-relight, transfers light from the light map to the picture.

fal.note: fal-ai/iclight-v2 or bria/fibo-edit/relight: relights with prompt guidance and directional latent / light direction.

inputs.value: relight the image using twilight light (with a warm color temperature, soft light, and blurred shadows)
